title: Chapter 47: Necromancer
content:
Chapter 47: Necromancer

Wang Shuo looked at Zhao Bonde walking away, full of fighting spirit.

After accepting his mission, Wang Shuo walked towards the Gobi with his subordinates.

Wang Shuo planned to raise the level of himself and others, and then challenge the Sword Skeleton King in the afternoon.

In the Gobi desert of the ancient battlefield, wind and sand blow all year round. When the wind is strong, the sand and rocks are blown away. These blown gravels are really a kind of torture for the skeleton soldiers.

But this is also a way for skeleton soldiers to temper their bones. After being polished with gravel, their physiques will become stronger.

Of course, there will also be some skeleton soldiers who will be blown away and completely destroyed.

Wang Shuo and his team have melee combatants, long-range combatants, and damage-resistance specialists. It can be said that they are an excellent combat team.

Now they are consciously integrating the team, developing tactics, and preparing to kill the skeleton boss.

At this moment, Chang Gui reminded: "Lord, there seems to be danger!"

Wang Shuo immediately became alert and led everyone to hide behind a huge rock.

Then he took out the telescope he got from opening the treasure chest before and started observing.

Soon he discovered something unusual. One kilometer away, a black-robed skeleton stood out from the crowd.

He held the staff in his hand and was casting a spell. The scattered skeletons in front of him were assembled into skeleton soldiers at a speed visible to the naked eye.

The distance was too far, and Wang Shuo could not carry out investigation, so he could only tell Chang Gui about the situation.

Although Chang Gui could sense the danger, he couldn't tell what kind of danger it was because the distance was too far.

After Wang Shuo's introduction, he thought for a while before writing in his "diary": "This kind of skeleton may be a necromancer. He has a skill that can summon skeleton soldiers from bones."

"This kind of skeleton soldiers can only exist for 24 hours, and their energy will be exhausted. If there is a battle, the consumption rate will accelerate, and when the time is up, they will turn into bones again."

"But during this period, if they absorb additional energy and resist for 24 hours, they will be reborn and become the skeleton soldiers we encountered before."

"It turns out to be a 'skeleton mother', which is interesting." Wang Shuo whispered.

There are a lot of skeleton soldiers around the necromancer, but they have almost no fighting power at the moment.

Wang Shuo directly ordered "attack".

Gong Zheng took the lead, holding a large shield as high as a person and rushed forward.

Wang Shuo also summoned a war horse, holding a fine spear in his hand, accelerated and flew out.

The targets he chose at the moment were all relatively weak skeleton soldiers, level 1, and they could basically break their skeletons apart with one blow.

Looking around, Wang Shuo was very satisfied that there really was no enemy in sight and that he was quite brave and unstoppable.

Soon, Gong Zheng and others also joined the battle. There were still some high-level skeleton soldiers around the undead wizard, but the presence of the golden-armored warriors could not pose a threat to Wang Shuo and others.

Wang Shuo was a little worried about whether this undead wizard had other skills.

Wandering around the battlefield, Wang Shuo took out his bow and arrow and shot an arrow at the undead wizard. A number "-30" immediately appeared on his head.

Wang Shuo used another investigative skill.

【Necromancer】

[Level: Level 7]

[Attack power: 60]

[Defense: 5]

[Health value: 1400]

[Skills: Summoning the Undead, Ball of Corrosion. 】

[Evaluation: The third-level undead arms in the ancient battlefield are weak in combat power, but there are often a large number of skeleton soldiers around them. 】

It was actually a third-level soldier, which surprised Wang Shuo!

But looking at his level, it was only level 7, which made Wang Shuo wonder if he was wrong.

There are only about 20 skeleton soldiers around him, and only 5 of them are capable of fighting. They don't look like third-level necromancers.

In fact, this undead wizard who lived near the Yellow Wind Valley camp had a fierce battle with his kind. He lost all his guards and his original level of 25 was dropped to level 7.

It can be said that it is very pitiful. At this moment, he is trying to recruit troops and restore his strength.

He hadn't seen a human being in many years, especially when he was at his weakest. At this moment, he felt a little panicked.

As a third-level undead, he already has spiritual intelligence, but unfortunately he does not understand human language.

Otherwise, he is likely to beg for mercy.

Seeing one of his bodyguards being cut into pieces by the golden-armored warrior, and neatly torn into a skeleton, he had the idea of escape at this moment.

But Wang Shuo didn't give him a chance. He rode around on his war horse and shot him an arrow from time to time, which made him a little intolerable.

Aimed at Wang Shuo, he released a "Corrosion Ball" skill.

A number "-120" immediately appeared on Wang Shuo's head, and at the same time, a large piece of his armor was corroded. Fortunately, he was protected by the armor, otherwise he would have suffered the pain of corroded flesh.

Wang Shuo was knocked off his horse by this blow. His riding skill level was only level 1, and his stability on the horse was still a bit poor.

At the same time, there was a surge of blood in his chest, and a trace of blood spilled from the corner of his mouth.

"It's very powerful!" Wang Shuo finally experienced the magic damage.

Although he was injured, Wang Shuo was not afraid. He immediately got up from the ground, put away his warhorse, and joined Gong Zheng and others to start the siege.

In this way, they could not only cooperate tactically, but also get the protection of their teammates, and their safety could be improved.

As a mage, the necromancer has weak melee ability, and his mental power was greatly consumed when he just cast the undead summon, so it was difficult for him to organize an effective resistance.

Not long after, Wang Shuo shot him to death.

[You killed the necromancer. ]

[Your level is upgraded to level 7, and you get 1 attribute point that can be allocated. ]

[Found 15 energy crystals and 1 soul crystal. Do you want to pick them up? ]

"Yes."

There was actually 1 soul crystal, which made Wang Shuo a little overjoyed.

The value of soul crystals is much higher than that of energy crystals, and many magical equipment require soul crystals.

Zhao Bangde once said that the high-level skeletons here all have soul crystals, and it seems to be true. After this battle, Wang Shuo's level reached 7, Gong Zheng reached 5, and Gong Ping and Gong Kai also reached 4.

And the team's cooperation also seemed to be more tacit.

Back to the camp, Wang Shuo found Zhao Bangde and used the military merit points to repair his equipment.

At the same time, he also exchanged some life potions, which can enhance the endurance. The opponents he met in the future will definitely become stronger and stronger, and it is inevitable to get injured and lose blood.

However, the exchange ratio made Wang Shuo feel a little distressed. 10 military merit points can be exchanged for one bottle, and each bottle can only restore 50 health points.

Wang Shuo called this medicine that restores health "Xiaohong". Of course, there is also "Dahong" that restores 200 health points each time, but the price is 50 military merit points. Wang Shuo said: The price is too expensive, I don't deserve it.

After exchanging 10 bottles of Xiaohong medicine, when the state returned to the peak, Wang Shuo and his party went straight to the place where the big knife skeleton king was.

It's time to test the strength of my team.
